4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Spectra is the core piece to add next time, most naturally in place of Dust Devil: a missing-health burst on stacked targets instead of attack speed and movement. If Khaimera keeps reaching Sparrow, Natural Resistance over Forage is the loadout-screen comparison: a cleanse when low in exchange for farm income. 4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.rewrite: Spectra, the missing piece of the common winning core, is the comparison for the Dust Devil slot: a missing-health burst on stacked targets in exchange for Dust Devil's attack speed and the movement speed that matters when Khaimera dives. 4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Maco skipped the common support core of Crescelia, Enra's Blessing and Windcaller for a front-line kit. Hexbound Bracers returns mana from damage taken and trims hero basic-attack damage; Tainted Guard adds armor and cuts the healing of whoever basic-attacks him, Khaimera included. Frosted Lure pulses damage, a slow and a shield while he stays near enemies, and Vyzar Carapace shields him once his own attacks and abilities stack three hits on an enemy hero. Timewarp shortens basic cooldowns. It fits our highest mitigation; it does not prove the build won or lost any fight.
